title: feat(metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, client)!: the dataset query door and /meta/dataset take the reader's package (?callerPackage=) and resolve the name by ADR-0150 D3
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9MPgD7mFnX4Q6NRcD45kbe)_

Fixes #32310

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: added

**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing at `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`: `?callerPackage=` was accepted and ignored (`200`, the bare read's dataset); it now resolves the name from that package (ADR-0150 D3) and answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (ambiguous in, or held only outside, the package's closure) or `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (beside `?package=`, blank, repeated). First-party senders before this change: 0, repo-wide with `ui/` included. The `/meta/dataset/:name` arm is the widening half: it was refused `400` as an unknown parameter. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset. Skills-docs: none (`skills/**` teaches neither the query door nor `?callerPackage=`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据集查询入口和 `/meta/dataset/:name` 新增 `?callerPackage=`,按"读者所在包"解析数据集名:先本包,再依赖闭包加 `sys` 中唯一持有者,否则 409。客户端 SDK 两个方法同步加了选项。
- 为什么改:`?package=` 只能精确指定持有包,包内页面读依赖包的数据集无从表达;这是 ADR-0150 D3 在这两个入口的落地,UI(#32309)切换的前提。
- 风险与回滚:查询入口以前会忽略这个参数,现在会拒绝或改为按包解析;仓内调用方 0 个。裸读与 `?package=` 两入口逐字节不变(实测 9/9)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`(`resolveCallerPackageAddress`,解析顺序与未安装包的处理);`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`(参数拒绝规则与查询改写);`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`(第二条传输的同一接线)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-routes.test.ts -t 32310`,预期 8 例全绿(本包、依赖包、两持有者 409、闭包外 409、双参数 400、未安装包同 `?package=`、503 兜底、对照组)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `resolveCallerPackageAddress({ type, name, callerPackageId, member? })` on the protocol. It composes core's `resolvePackageScopedHolders` rule with metadata-core's `packageResolutionClosure` over the registry's own reads (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, `getPackageScopedItem`, `getEnvironmentScopedItem`), and answers the holder to read: a package id, or the environment. Ambiguity and outside-closure throw `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`). A caller that is not an installed package (no registry entry, no residual owner) is answered as its own id, so the read becomes exactly `?package=<that id>` and never the bare read.
- **`@objectstack/rest`**: `callerPackage` joins the `/meta` item read's closed query set, with a fourth refusal rule (`metaItemCallerPackageRefusalMessage`): `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming both parameters when it is sent with `?package=`, on a type other than `dataset`, or blank. The qualified path `/meta/dataset/NS/:name` refuses it the same way. `metaCallerPackageQuery` resolves through the protocol and rewrites the query to `?package=<holder>` (or drops it for the environment), so admission and every answer after resolution are the qualified read's. The dataset query door takes the same parameter, refuses a repeat, and runs the resolved holder's dataset; an inline `dataset` body ignores it like `?package=`. A protocol with no resolver answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**: the dispatcher's `/meta` item read and qualified path carry the same rules through the shared `@objectstack/rest` decision.
- **`@objectstack/client`**: `analytics.queryDataset(payload, { callerPackage })` and `meta.getItem(type, name, { callerPackage })` (both the unscoped and the scoped client) send it.
- **Docs**: one paragraph in `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` beside `?package=`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (real `SchemaRegistry` + protocol): own, dependency, `sys`, two in closure (409 naming both), outside closure, environment-only (409 outside-closure), uninstalled caller equals `?package=`, nothing holds the name, CONTROL.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`: both `/meta` transports, real registry, including the qualified-path 400 and the CONTROL.
- `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`: the query door, 8 cases including the 503 fail-closed protocol.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-query-decision.test.ts`: rule 4.
- `packages/client/src/package-addressing.test.ts`: the three client options.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/dataset-package-scoped-readers.dogfood.test.ts`: a booted stack with four caller packages, 6 new cases.
- Forced test changes (each roster pins the parameter set or a method's source): the `/meta` closed-set lists in `meta-item-query-decision.test.ts` (rest and runtime) and `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts`, the canonical-fold roster in `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`, and the `queryDataset` source pin in `envelope-caller-census.test.ts`. Three touched test files gained a module-top side-effect import so a lazy load is paid at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).

## Acceptance notes

- The holder set is the bare read's (`packageScopedHoldersOf`), so it counts a disabled package the same way the bare read does today; #32183 is not landed.
- The resolution is composed in metadata-protocol from core's rule and metadata-core's closure, because metadata-protocol cannot import objectql's `resolvePackageScopedName` adapter. It is the same three reads.
- The caller is read only from the explicit query parameter, never from a header or the session.
- An unknown caller package answers what `?package=` answers for that id: `409` naming the holders, `404` when nothing holds the name.

### out_of_scope_findings

- carrier `seat`: the ui callers of #32309 switch from `package` to `callerPackage` (`analytics.queryDataset(payload, { callerPackage })` and `meta.getItem('dataset', name, { callerPackage })`), so a package page reads a dependency's dataset.
- carrier `seat`: batch door arm. The #32200 batch door is not merged; its second lander adds the same arm per query.

## Verification

All on head `d36fa591` (main merged at `84208647`), under the repo verify lock.

<details><summary>Step 0 reading on main (premise holds) and the census</summary>

- Booted showcase plus caller packages on main `351c22c9`. The query door with `?package=P` for a dependency's dataset: `409` not-held-by-qualifier. The bare door: `200`, serving the dependency's dataset. `/meta/dataset/d?package=P`: `409`. `?package=<unknown>`: `409` naming the holders on both doors (`404` when nothing holds the name).
- The query door with `?callerPackage=P` was accepted and ignored: `200`, the bare read. `/meta/dataset/:name?callerPackage=` was `400` as an unknown parameter.
- Census: 0 senders of `callerPackage=` repo-wide, `ui/` included. Live: 16 dashboard, report and view dataset references on the booted stack (plugin-auth `system_overview` 4, showcase 12), each its own package's. Static examples (todo, crm, showcase, multi-package, the blank template): 0.
</details>

<details><summary>CONTROL: bare read and ?package= unchanged byte for byte</summary>

The same probe on main and on head: 9/9 bare and `?package=` answers byte-identical on both doors, and the census is equal. On head, `?callerPackage=P` for a holder outside P's closure answers `409 outside-closure` where the bare read answers `200`: the declared narrowing.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

The `resolvePackageScopedHolders` call in `resolveCallerPackageAddress` replaced with a constant `not-found` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt, marker preflighted in `dist/` (both entry files hit). Pins red: objectql 5 of 9, rest 5 of 15, runtime 2 of 5 (the own-dataset, refusal and CONTROL cases stay green, as they do not depend on resolution). Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean, the same suites green: 36/36, 59/59, 29/29.
</details>

<details><summary>Builds, suites and gates</summary>

- Full build before the merge: `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` exit 0. After the merge: the closure of metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, client and objectql, 42/42.
- Typecheck exit 0: metadata-protocol, rest, runtime, client, objectql.
- Full suites: metadata-protocol 22658 passed (one roster pin updated, then green), rest 7717 passed (one roster pin updated, then green), runtime 9660 passed, client 803 passed (one source pin updated, then green).
- Dogfood, the whole battery: 449 files passed, 3 skipped; 3755 tests passed, 42 skipped.
- `pnpm lint` exit 0; `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` OK; `check-adr-0087-registration` green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two first-run reds were environmental or fixed and rerun green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone, the pinned fixture commit fetched) and `check:test-source-alias` (three touched test files now pay a lazy load at collection).
- Diff against main: 23 files, +1000 / -24, under the 3000-line budget.
</details>
